contexts: 23 primary schools, clinic day about every three weeks
four dental therapists with portable equipment
separate SDF consent, forms in school bags
data analyst one day a week
reading: The value stream runs from screening, through consent, to a clinic day and the call from class. Most of the elapsed time is waiting for consent (c1), and each three-weekly clinic day is a single chance per child. The combined form (c2) and a need-ordered call list (c4) attack waiting and rework; the staining leaflet addresses the reason some parents refuse (c3). Language sits upstream of consent (c5), so a pathway that looks faster on average may leave the same children behind. Teachers and office staff carry parts of the flow without owning it.
